about_the_game:
An inexplicable portal has appeared, devouring the surrounding plants and trees. Countless infected skeletons and monsters pour out of the portal, their target being the "Guardian Stone Tablet" on the island. Once the stone tablet is destroyed, the entire island will be completely shrouded in plague.

So far, the plague has eroded several islands and is continuing to spread outward. At this moment, a distress signal comes from a border village: the plague portal has opened, and infected creatures may invade at any time. The Guardian Stone Tablet in the village needs your protection.

You will play the role of a magic tower defender on the island, using a bow and arrow as well as a magical sand table to fend off enemy invasions.

The six core highlights of Divine Archer Tower Defense will take you into a fantasy world where strategy and action intertwine:

1. Magical Sand Table: Intertwining Virtual and Real

Take control of a mysterious strategic sand table. Every layout and deduction you make here can be mapped in real time and affect the in-game world ahead, as if you possess the magic to manipulate reality. Players can place defense towers on the magical sand table, which corresponds to the in-game map on a 1:1 scale. At the same time, identical defense towers will rise in the real-world scene corresponding to the sand table, and you can use various defense towers to block the enemy's attack.

2. Dual-Front Combat: Stirring Strategy

You not only need to make overall plans and carefully arrange various arrow towers and fortifications; you can also personally draw the bow and shoot arrows, resolving crises with precise shots, and enjoying the dual fun of strategic layout and action operations.

3. Power of Creation: Crafted by You

From editing the map with every blade of grass and every tree to designing the level events wave by wave, powerful creation tools are in your hands. Create a unique battlefield and invite friends to challenge your masterpiece. The desktop version of the game allows players to customize maps and levels, letting you build a battlefield of your own.

4. Multi-Platform Immersion: Seamless Cross-Border Gameplay

The game supports two gameplay modes: traditional PC desktop and VR. This allows you to either make strategies in a comfortable setting or step into the battlefield as if you were really there, fully experiencing the thrill of defending and drawing the bow to shoot arrows.

5. Free Shooting Range: Do as You Wish

The shooting range is not only a training camp for honing your archery skills and testing new weapons, but also a safe space where you can move freely, explore, and discover surprises—providing a place to relax amid the intense battles.

6. Player Command Room: Masterminding Strategies

This is your strategic core! Here, you can not only configure and upgrade equipment and weapons, and purchase scarce resources, but also move freely. The achievement trophies unlocked in the game will be displayed here, recording your gaming career.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or higher
  • Processor: Intel Core ​​i5-4590 / AMD FX 8350
  • Memory: 8000 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 or AMD Radeon R9 290X
  • Storage: 1024 MB available space
  • VR Support: Supports OpenXR, requires motion controllers
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core ​​i7-6700​​ / ​​AMD Ryzen 5 2600X​
  • Memory: 16000 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 or AMD Radeon RX 570
  • Storage: 1024 MB available space
  • VR Support: Supports OpenXR, requires motion controllers

short_description: Mysterious island portals unleash plague monsters targeting "Guardian Monuments"—their destruction dooms the island. As defender, use a bow (break armor/hit weak points) and a magic sandtable: place towers, real ones rise to block. Game has VR/desktop versions and map editing for custom levels.
